name: KNOWN GAP (legacy path): renaming the anchor while flipping isn't seen as a completion
description: #475 gap 2, pinned as current behavior. The run is still going; in one edit the model flips the checkbox and renames the step's anchor. The post-image step key isn't the pre-image's, so the gate sees no flip and writes no evidence.decision row, even in deny mode. Closes for raw submissions with loom_submit; the registry-path twin is refused.
